integrity: The historical Selkov source was inspected as a complete eight-page article, and the exact modern two-parameter normalization and primary MSC classification were checked against a same-object phase-portrait article. A complete open mathematical study of Selkov dynamics was inspected with targeted searches for invariant-measure, average, and moment formulations. The proof was independently reconstructed from the flow generator, and the algebraic certificates were replayed from the packaged checker. No numerical trajectory is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures; unbounded Selkov solutions are outside its scope.
It constrains conditional moments and exact fluctuation defects but does not determine a full invariant density or the parameter region of periodic-orbit existence.
The complete text of the 2022 exact-normalization phase-portrait article was not accessible in the inspected source.
A differently phrased equivalent identity could remain in unindexed biochemical-dynamics literature.
title: Exact stationary mass-balance and harmonic substrate defects in the Selkov oscillator
